_comment: The `tables` array is GENERATED from appwrite/schema/*.json by schema_build.py (edit the schema files, then run `python3 appwrite/schema_build.py --write`; tests fail when stale). Other sections are hand-edited. Project id is injected per environment by CI (environments.json), never committed. Rules from ADR 0012: row security on, empty table-level permissions, no client create/update/delete. Bucket `teacher-docs` follows ADR 0012 (owner + opsadmin only, set per file by the core service).
